items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Liberty and Padilla. I don't know who place was that.

ctx.x: And then, see, I had them. Whose place was that? Do you remember? No.
Liberty and Padilla. I don't know who place was that.
Uh, Bunk used to talk about a fellow they called Mustache that ran that place. Some Italian.
